representation: finite multiset of ordered root-to-leaf paths

operations.zero: empty path multiset (structural zero object; not a claim of physical nothingness)
operations.one: single empty path, acting as algebraic multiplicative identity

formal_observation.distributivity: both left and right distributivity hold by expansion over path multisets
formal_observation.multiplication: generally noncommutative because path order matters
formal_observation.overall_candidate: a noncommutative semiring-like path algebra for structural content

omega_interpretation: Addition places structural histories together without erasing either.
Multiplication composes one structural history after another; order matters.
The empty multiset is an algebraic structural zero, but this does not mean 'absolute nothingness' in the Omega cosmological sense.
A realized Omega object still needs unique birth/history labels on top of the structural algebra; algebraic equality of structures does not imply identity equality of realizations.
importance: Unlike the rejected grafting product, this operation set satisfies stable algebraic laws and is derived directly from ordered hierarchical paths.
